newsitem.title: USA: McDermott Intl to sell shipyard.
newsitem.headline: McDermott Intl to sell shipyard.

text.p: McDermott International Inc said on Monday its McDermott Shipbuilding Inc unit reached an agreement to sell its shipyard near Amelia, Louisiana to Bollinger Shipyards Inc of Lockport, Louisiana.
The sale would include the assets of the shipyard including its current backlog of work, McDermott said.
The companies were expected to complete the transaction by the end of February, it said. The price was not disclosed.
The sale did not include the marine construction fabrication yard operated by McDermott's J. Ray McDermott subsidiary, also located near Amelia, the company said.
Bollinger planned to continue to operate the yard, which primarily manufactures fuel, hopper and cargo barges, it said.
Bollinger would assume McDermott's work in progress, including a three-year contract to build a series of river hopper barges, the company said.
Bollinger planned to offer employment to substantially all McDermott employees working in the yard, it said.
Bollinger Shipyards owns and operates 20 drydocks in six shipyards in the New Orleans and southern Louisiana area.
